(Japanese: '''VS ホウオウ''' ''VS {{tt|Houou|Ho-Oh}}''), titled '''The Mightiest Ho-Oh''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 153rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 63rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At [[Team Rocket]]'s [[Johto]] base, the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]] are being punished for their failures by [[Carl]] and [[Sham]]. The [[Masked Man]] emerges from a circular opening on the ground, along with his {{p|Delibird}}. As Carl and Sham appraise their leader as usual, the Elite Trio see their new boss for the very first time. The Masked Man freezes Al up to his neck, then turns to leave as Carl and Sham follow him towards a balcony where the rest of Team Rocket await. Carl announces that the public will be ready to witness Team Rocket's resurrection by hijacking the event taking place at the [[Indigo Plateau]] the next day. The Team Rocket members down below rejoice. The Masked Man then prepares to leave, stating that it is the right time to revisit a certain place. The next morning, {{tc|Camper}} [[Evan]] and {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} are among the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s registering their names for the tournament proper at the [[Indigo Plateau]]. They have a practice battle between each other before doing so. After the registration, Miles notices the long queue of Trainers waiting for registration and thinks they will have many qualifying rounds. He also remembers the new rule that permits direct entry into the tournament for those who collected all eight [[Kanto]] or all eight [[Johto]] badges. The two eventually find their seats among the audience as the opening ceremony of the tournament begins, with the [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman greeting the audience. [[DJ Mary|Mary]], the former singer and current radio show host, announces from the announcer's box that 20,000 applications were received for the tournament, and 700 of them have succeeded in entering the preliminary qualifying round. Mary also mentions that all of the league's past winners were from [[Pallet Town]] in Kanto. The Chairman then announces the current [[Pokémon League]] {{pkmn|Champion}} - after the spotlight shines on an empty spot, the Chairman only then receives word that {{adv|Red}} isn't at the stadium, so he plays clips of the match between Red and {{adv|Blue}} on the big screen, much to the audience's dissatisfaction. Afterwards, the Chairman announces the {{wp|exhibition game|exhibition match}}es of the Kanto and Johto [[Gym Leader]]s. Meanwhile, the Masked Man arrives at the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]] on his {{p|Delibird}}. The statue inside the tower glows, and Delibird brings its Trainer to an altitude above the clouds to face {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}}, the legendary bird that hasn't been under the Masked Man's control for nine years. ==Major events== * The tenth Pokémon League begins. * The [[Masked Man]] begins his battle with {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Slowking}} * {{p|Magcargo}} * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (video) * {{adv|Blue}} (video) * [[Masked Man]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]] * [[Sham]] * [[Carl]] * [[DJ Mary]] * [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman * [[Radio Director]] * {{tc|Camper}} [[Evan]] * {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} * {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s * {{tc|Firebreather}} * {{tc|Poké Fan}} * {{tc|School Kid}} * {{tc|Hiker}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; video) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}; video) * {{p|Delibird}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Persian}} ({{adv|Miles}}'s) * {{p|Haunter}} ([[Evan]]'s) * {{p|Slowking}} ([[Sham]]'s) * {{p|Magcargo}} ([[Carl]]'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{tc|Poké Fan}}'s) * {{p|Yanma}} ({{tc|School Kid}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} ({{tc|Hiker}}'s) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 鳳王|VS Ho-Oh}} (Taiwan)
